title: Christmas Day in Santa suits: Nara deer and the Great Buddha, Umeda Sky at sunset, the last night of the Christmas lights, A5 Matsusaka wagyu, Amerikamura bars and a Round1 all-nighter

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Last full day in Osaka: everyone in Santa suits (the Umekita parade suits, or Donki ones as a fallback) from the first step out the door.

stops.name: Kujō House: suitcases to Garfield House by TA-Q-BIN, konbini breakfast
stops.plan: Hand the big suitcases to Yamato TA-Q-BIN for Sat 26 evening delivery at Garfield House (host confirmed); grab a konbini breakfast; keep only overnight bags and passports.
stops.transport: Walk to Kujō station, Osaka Metro Chuo line Kujō → Nagata, Kintetsu Keihanna line → Ikoma, Kintetsu Nara line express → Kintetsu-Nara, walk through Nara Park to Tōdai-ji, about 90 min door to door

stops.name: Tōdai-ji (Great Buddha Hall)
stops.plan: Eight Santas under the Great Buddha; no group photos or tripods inside the hall.

stops.name: Nara Park deer
stops.plan: Shika senbei for the bowing deer; Santas being chased by deer is the photo of the trip.
stops.transport: Walk west along Noborioji to Nakatanidō by Kintetsu-Nara, 20 min

stops.name: Nakatanidō
stops.plan: Warm yomogi mochi to eat on the street, a snack not a meal; catch the high-speed pounding if a round is on.
stops.transport: Kintetsu Nara line express Kintetsu-Nara → Osaka-Namba, Osaka Metro Midosuji line Namba → Umeda, walk to the Umeda Sky Building, about 85 min door to door

stops.name: Okonomiyaki Kiji
stops.plan: Okonomiyaki and yakisoba in the retro Takimi-kōji alley under Umeda Sky; expect a queue and to sit in two groups.
stops.transport: Walk to LUCUA at Osaka Station, 12 min

stops.name: LUCUA Osaka (Nintendo OSAKA, LUCUA 1100)
stops.plan: Nintendo OSAKA on 13F and a quick LUCUA 1100 sweep; bring passports for tax-free.
stops.transport: Walk back under the tracks to the Umeda Sky Building, 12 min

stops.name: Umeda Sky Building – Kuchu Teien + Christmas 2026
stops.plan: Open-air Floating Garden from golden hour through sunset (about 16:50) into the lit night skyline, on the last day of THE STARLIGHT TOWN Christmas event; last entry 22:00.
stops.transport: Walk to Umeda, Osaka Metro Midosuji line Umeda → Yodoyabashi, walk to the Central Public Hall, about 35 min door to door

stops.name: Osaka Hikari Renaissance (Nakanoshima)
stops.plan: Projection mapping on the Central Public Hall (about 10 min, every 12 min) on its final night.
stops.transport: Walk to Yodoyabashi, Osaka Metro Midosuji line Yodoyabashi → Shinsaibashi (2 stops), about 25 min door to door

stops.name: Midosuji Illumination 2026
stops.plan: Walk the lit ginkgo avenue south from Shinsaibashi towards Dotonbori, Santas on parade.
stops.transport: Walk to Matsusakagyu Yakiniku M in Sennichimae, 2 min

stops.name: Matsusakagyu Yakiniku M
stops.plan: A5 Matsusaka beef Premium course for 8 in the group hall (book via Japan Food Guide; 30 min late counts as a no-show).
stops.transport: Walk west across Midosuji into Amerikamura, 9 min

stops.name: PC & Retro Bar Space Station
stops.plan: Free Famicom, N64 and PlayStation with themed cocktails; Santas versus Mario Kart. It is small, so take turns at the consoles.

stops.name: Amerikamura & Triangle Park bars
stops.plan: Plan C's Christmas night: konbini toast in Triangle Park, then the small bars in the walk-ups around it. No clubs (group rule), so skip Circus and the club door touts.
stops.transport: Walk east across Midosuji to Round1 Sennichimae, 13 min

stops.name: Round1 Stadium Sennichimae
stops.plan: The Christmas all-nighter: arcade first (closes earlier), then a midnight-to-morning karaoke pack or Spo-Cha until the first train; passports for the ID check.
stops.price: Karaoke from ¥440 pp minimum order + ¥390 drink bar

stops.name: Kinryu Ramen Dotonbori
stops.plan: Dragon-sign ramen with free kimchi as the sun-up closer.
stops.transport: Walk to Osaka-Namba, first Hanshin Namba line train 05:42 to Kujō (2 stops), walk home, about 40 min door to door

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Short night #1: sleep until checkout at 10:00.
